# Clavis Encrypt 3.11.3

## 🛠️ Fixed: editing a file someone shared with several people

- If you opened an "Encrypt for someone" file with **Open without saving**, edited it and saved, Clavis replaced it with a copy locked with your password, so the other people it was meant for could no longer open it.
- Now the shared file is left exactly as it was, and your changes are saved as a new encrypted file in the same folder, which opens with your password. Clavis tells you where it is.

## Install / upgrade

- **Windows, already installed:** the app updates itself (Settings → Updates → Check now), or download the new installer from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.
- **Microsoft Store:** the Store updates it automatically.
- **Linux:** install the new `.deb` from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.

Your vaults and settings are kept.
